remarks: Welcome to 59 Holbrook Drive-a rare opportunity to own a sprawling mid-century ranch on an oversized .71-acre corner lot in a highly desirable mid-city Stamford location. This classic 1951 home greets you with a wonderful circular drive and showcases charming vintage features of its era. Gleaming hardwood floors flow throughout large and gracious formal rooms perfect for entertaining. A den with built-in bookshelves offers a quiet retreat or home office space. The kitchen retains its original character and is enhanced by a bright windowed breakfast room that floods the space with natural light and sunny eastern exposures and is adjacent to the formal dining room. Enjoy indoor-outdoor living from the screened porch off the living room-perfect for seasonal enjoyment. Three generous sized bedrooms are privately tucked at one end of the house. The oversized lot provides exceptional privacy and potential for outdoor amenities, gardens, or expansion. Ideally situated for convenient living, the home is walking distance to schools, shops, and houses of worship. Modern conveniences include city sewer, city water, and natural gas. This is a fantastic opportunity to personalize a classic ranch with solid bones and tremendous potential in an established, accessible neighborhood.
